Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters and sort order to check on a project, this one's for you. Now you can set up a view exactly how you like it — filtered, sorted, grouped — and save it for one click access anytime.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep separate setups for different projects, priorities, or clients without losing track of any of them. Need your teammates looking at the same thing you are? Saved Views can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating it individually.

Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a specific sprint, or just want your default view to open exactly the way you left it, Saved Views makes it easy to get back to what matters. No extra setup, no add-ons required — it's already part of your plan.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
